tools.name: health_check
tools.description: Check MCP server health status. Verify this server is operational and get basic server information (name, version, auth method). Use for connectivity testing and diagnostics. No authentication required.

tools.name: submit_address_verification
tools.description: Submit companies for address verification. Validate company addresses and verify organization legitimacy. Returns entity IDs for tracking verification results.

tools.name: submit_hierarchy_creation
tools.description: Submit companies for organizational hierarchy creation. Identify parent-subsidiary relationships and organizational structure. Returns entity IDs for tracking hierarchy results.

tools.name: get_request_status
tools.description: Get screening request status and results. Check if request is complete (PENDING/PROCESSING/COMPLETE/FAILED) and retrieve results. Returns organizational hierarchy, company verification, or deduplication screening data.

tools.name: submit_duplicates
tools.description: Submit duplicate entities from file. Upload JSON, CSV, or Excel files containing duplicate account records for deduplication detection.

findings.title: Tool removed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "submit_entities" is no longer advertised. Removal can precede a shadowing replacement from another server.
